description.above_fold_verbatim:

Grokbot just shipped four big updates that make it the easiest way to run a whole team of AI agents for marketing, coding, or any other kind of work. The last one fixes the biggest reason agents get blocked on the internet.
description.full_text:
This is an Agent Native Episode.

Grokbot just shipped four big updates that make it the easiest way to run a whole team of AI agents for marketing, coding, or any other kind of work. The last one fixes the biggest reason agents get blocked on the internet.
-Primary Bot: Now there's one team leader to talk to, and it hands each task to the right bot for you. I asked for a redesign of my Native Note app, and it passed the job to my dev bot, which used Cursor with Opus 5.5 and pushed the change straight to prod.
-I called my primary bot from the Grokbot iOS app while out on a walk. Hands-free, it sent YouTube research to my content bot and landing page fixes to the right agent.
-Team Bots: Shared, isolated bots for your whole team. They start with their own plugins, publish to your team, and live in Slack. When teammates use one, it connects to their own logins like Gmail, so nobody's account gets shared.

Then there are the quieter updates I genuinely love. Inline drafts turn email and Slack messages into little mini apps you can edit, approve, and send right in the chat. And "Route traffic through this computer" makes your bot's cloud computer browse from your own internet connection, so sites like Target stop flagging it as a bot.

Subscribe to my new vlog channel:    / @rileybrown-2

description.full_text:
This is an Agent Native Episode.

Google says it's about to release the best model in the world, but only cyber defenders can use it. Meanwhile, OpenAI just launched its own personal agent platform inside ChatGPT.
-Anthropic dropped Sonnet 5.5 just six days after Opus 5.5. I've put 30+ hours into Opus 5.5 and still haven't hit my limits.
-I called my OpenAI Dots agent, Bluey. Hands-free, it sent emails and Slack messages, then spun up a local Codex session to redesign my landing page.
-GPT Space is like Notion built into ChatGPT, where your agent writes docs and diagrams for you. Plus, plugin extensions let ChatGPT work inside other apps like MagicPath.

And then the biggest question of the week: is Gemini 4 Argon actually as good as Google says? Google hasn't had a great model since January, and it still hasn't picked one app to use it in. Plus, GrokBot quietly added proactive suggestions, inline email drafts, Slack team bots, and a way to route its traffic through your own computer.
